description: `--input` only ever lands in a writer's own worktree (cli.py:3308-3315): a read-only role already runs in the shared checkout, where every path `--input` would name is one it can open directly, so dispatch refuses before any card is built rather than silently accepting a flag that does nothing. Written against the current role names directly (`[roles.scout]`) rather than a pre-rename fixture: this check is new port behavior with no recorded Python transcript to replay, and none of `role_translate.py`'s fixed rewrite positions cover this sentence, so an old-named fixture would not translate correctly at Rust replay time.

home.config_toml:
[accounts.scout-seat]
kind = "codex"
config_dir_var = "CODEX_HOME"
config_dir = "{{DIR:codex-home}}"
pool = "codex:test"

[projects.sandbox]
path = "{{PROJECT:sandbox}}"

[projects.sandbox.chains]
scout = ["scout-seat"]

[roles.scout]
write_scope = "none"
effort = "low"
on_exhausted = "degrade"
skills = []

[roles.scout.models]
codex = "gpt-test"

stderr_contains: --input is for a writing role; Scout is read-only and runs in the shared checkout, where it can already open any of these paths directly. Drop --input, or dispatch a writing role.
